# Loment 0.1.5.1-hot.2

This is the second hot-update Pre-Release on the `0.1.5.1` line. Unlike `hot.1` it ships a
**toolchain generation payload**, not just the running LSP image, so the build-time fixes that
`hot.1` could not deliver actually reach installed toolchains.

## The line

| Fix | What it changes |
|---|---|
| `#1830` | `getelementptr`'s **first** index steps by the pointee's size and leaves the type at the pointee. A `[64 x i64], i64 cap_id` row advances 512 bytes, not 8. Fixed in both linkers. |
| `#1828` | The PE `openat` shim implements the Linux flag semantics: `O_RDWR` read+write, `O_APPEND` appends to existing contents, `O_EXCL` with `O_CREAT` fails on an existing file instead of truncating it. |
| `#1695` | Hot-update admission verifies the candidate against a release key **pinned in the running tree**. A candidate that ships its own public key is not trusted. |

## What is in the box

* `candidate.hot` — the running LSP image (`hot.1`'s payload), still admitted by the same
  rules.
* `payload-linux-x64.hot` / `payload-windows-x64.hot` — the toolchain generation: every tool in
  `bin/` (driver, linker, CLI, fmt, doc, LSP, `lompi`, `loment-lvm`, `flomtc`), built from the
  projection of the baseline plus the fixes above. Each payload is signed with a raw Ed25519
  key; the matching public key is pinned at `share/loment/hot/release-key.ed25519`.
* `loment-hotupdate-linux-x64` / `loment-hotupdate-windows-x64.exe` — the **native updater**.
  It verifies the signature and every file digest itself (the standard library's `ed25519` and
  `sha512` ship with the toolchain), writes the inactive generation, and only then flips
  `share/loment/hot/current`. `--check`, `--rollback`, `--status` are supported.
* `bootstrap-hotfix.sh` / `bootstrap-hotfix.cmd` — one-time bootstrap for installations that
  predate the updater (see below).

## Installing on a stock 0.1.5.1

An installation made before this release has no updater, no pinned key and no admission
baseline, and its launcher only looks at `bin/`. Use the bootstrap:

```sh
sh bootstrap-hotfix.sh "$HOME/.local" .     # Linux / WSL
```

```bat
bootstrap-hotfix.cmd %LOCALAPPDATA%\Loment .
```

Compare the script, the updater and the two launchers against the digests published in this
release's body **out of band** before running it — those digests live outside the archive on
purpose. The bootstrap creates the two generation slots, installs the updater, the pinned key,
the baseline and the new launcher, then runs the updater. After that this is an ordinary
install: later hot updates are just

```sh
loment hotupdate --payload payload-linux-x64.hot --sig payload-linux-x64.hot.sig
```

and the previous generation stays on disk for `--rollback`.

Reinstalling with a full package from this commit onward has the same effect (the installer
creates the generation slots and installs the launcher that reads `current`).

## Verify

```sh
gpg --import loment-signing.asc
gpg --verify SHA256SUMS.asc SHA256SUMS
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS
# after bootstrap:
loment hotupdate --status
```
